summary.text: Mark J. Peake is a Republican member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 8, which covers all of Bedford County, Campbell County and Lynchburg City, and has served in the Senate since 2017.
Peake sits on the Senate committees on Commerce and Labor; Courts of Justice; Education and Health; and Rehabilitation and Social Services.

paragraphs.text: Mark J. Peake was born in Greensboro, North Carolina, and raised in Roanoke, Virginia, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Peake's education as Virginia Tech (B.A.) and Washington & Lee University School of Law (J.D.).
The profile gives Peake's occupation as attorney.
